title: Month-End Close: Compliance and Contract Fallout
description: The board wants to understand whether the BudgetAir agreement protected the airport, whether the audit trail is defensible, and whether debt-funded growth is still under control.

questions.prompt: Why does a clawback clause only help if the contract terms are enforceable and tracked?
choices: Because recovery depends on documented performance obligations, measurable triggers, and evidence that the carrier missed the agreed terms.
Because all clawbacks happen automatically when revenue falls.
Because the board can simply declare cash recovered.
questions.explanation: Clawback recovery needs enforceable terms, measurement, and evidence. A vague right is not cash.

questions.prompt: Why can accepting a weak incentive contract create later audit and operational risk?
choices: Because unclear terms make it harder to support accounting treatment, enforce performance obligations, and explain cash outflows.
Because weak contracts always improve reputation.
Because audit risk only comes from payroll.
Because operational risk disappears after the contract is signed.
questions.explanation: Contract clarity is part of the control environment around incentive spending.

questions.prompt: Why does compliance preparation reduce audit pressure even though it costs cash?
choices: Because documentation, reconciliations, and approval evidence reduce uncertainty and control risk.
Because spending cash always creates revenue.
Because compliance work removes debt from the balance sheet.
questions.explanation: Good evidence lowers control uncertainty even when the work has a cash cost.

questions.prompt: Why does debt-funded growth require a covenant narrative?
choices: Because added debt and interest can pressure DSCR, liquidity, and lender confidence even if cash temporarily improves.
Because covenants are only marketing slogans.
Because DSCR improves whenever debt increases.
Because banks do not read financial statements.
questions.explanation: Debt can buy runway, but it adds repayment and interest pressure that must be explained.
